title: [PLACEHOLDER] Business Name Registration (Western Province)
action: Register the business name with the Department of Business Names (Western Province) within 14 days of establishment.
source_text: [PLACEHOLDER LEGAL TEXT] Every individual or firm carrying on business under a business name in the Western Province shall register such business name with the Registrar of Business Names.

title: [PLACEHOLDER] Food Hygiene Inspection & PHI Clearance License
action: Obtain a Food Handling & Hygiene License from the Municipal Health Department before commencing operations.
source_text: [PLACEHOLDER LEGAL TEXT] No person shall prepare, package, store, or sell any food item for public consumption without obtaining prior sanitation inspection and clearance from the Medical Officer of Health (MOH).

title: [PLACEHOLDER] Commercial Garment Retail & Trade Safety Permit
action: Obtain Local Authority Trade Permit and Fire Department Safety Clearance for textile retail premises.
source_text: [PLACEHOLDER LEGAL TEXT] Any premises engaged in the retail sale or storage of textiles, garments, and apparel must obtain a commercial trade permit subject to compliance with municipal fire safety standards.
documents_needed: Premises Tenancy Agreement or Title Deed
Local Authority Rates Clearance / Assessment Receipt

title: [PLACEHOLDER] Salon Sanitary Clearance & Chemical Safety Registration
action: Register salon premises and secure sanitary clearance for cosmetic procedures and chemical treatments.
authority: Municipal Health Department / National Cosmetics Authority
source_text: [PLACEHOLDER LEGAL TEXT] Establishments offering beauty, hairdressing, or skin care services using registered chemical cosmetics and sterilization apparatus shall obtain an annual sanitary certificate.
documents_needed: Safety Data Sheets (SDS) for Chemical Cosmetics Used

title: [PLACEHOLDER] Vehicle Spare Parts Trade & Hazardous Waste Disposal Permit
action: Obtain Local Council Trade License and Environmental Protection clearance for battery and waste lubricant handling.
source_text: [PLACEHOLDER LEGAL TEXT] Any business storing, distributing, or retailing automotive spare parts that generates scheduled waste such as spent lead-acid batteries or used mineral oil shall secure prescribed environmental clearance.
documents_needed: Hazardous Waste / Used Battery Storage Plan
